lines.en: label beachfive7:
scene sky
: Finally! The greatest part of the day!
lines.zh: : 终于到了！一天里最棒的时刻！

lines.en: scene mayaeats1
: The time for me to eat and not be disturbed by anyone!
lines.zh: : 我可以吃东西、不被任何人打扰的时间！

lines.en: What Maya Makinami did not know at this point in time is that she {i}would{/i} be disturbed. But not before another vague monologue about things that will only kinda sorta make sense.
lines.zh: Maya Makinami 此刻还不知道的是，她确实{i}会{/i}被打扰。但在此之前，先来又一段含糊的独白，讲的都是些只勉强说得通的东西。

lines.en: At least for now. But you don’t have to worry about cottontails or deer parts or eggs or flowers or any other recurring symbol this time.
lines.zh: 至少目前是这样。不过这次你不用担心棉尾兔、鹿的器官、卵、花，或者任何反复出现的意象了。

lines.en: Instead, you just have to worry about a little thing called “love,” which you may or may not be familiar with based on how adept you are at communicating with actual human beings.
lines.zh: 取而代之的是，你只需要担心一样叫做「爱」的小东西——至于你熟不熟悉它，就看你跟真正的人类沟通得有多熟练了。

lines.en: If you’ve made it this far, I’d wager you’re not very good at all. But that’s not an attack on you or anything of the sort. It’s more of just an...observation.
lines.zh: 如果你能走到这一步，我敢说你根本不怎么样。但这不是在针对你之类的，只是……一个观察而已。

lines.en: You see, love is all about the “give and take.” But mostly, it’s about the take since the whole point of life is ending with more than you started off with.
lines.zh: 你看，爱讲究的是「有给有取」。但主要是「取」，因为人生的全部意义就在于死的时候比出生时拥有得更多。

lines.en: But for Maya Makinami, dying (if we’re going to call it that) actually worked in her favor. And that’s the complete opposite of how it is for all of those one-lifers out there.
lines.zh: 但对 Maya Makinami 来说，死亡（如果非得这么称呼的话）反而帮了她。这和外面那些只有一条命的人完全相反。

lines.en: She wasn’t exactly {i}happy{/i} right now, but she did have {i}something.{/i} And that put her several steps above a bunch of miserable people out there.
lines.zh: 她现在算不上{i}幸福{/i}，但她确实拥有{i}某样东西{/i}。而这就让她比外面一堆痛苦的人高出好几档。

lines.en: That thing she had was currently eating away at her happiness, though — just as {i}she{/i} is about to eat the over-sized lunch spread you see before you.
lines.zh: 不过{i}她{/i}拥有的那样东西此刻正在蚕食她的幸福——就像她正准备吃掉你眼前这堆超量的午餐一样。

lines.en: It’s hard to love someone who doesn’t know how to love you back. And it’s even harder when you don’t really know how to love in the first place.
lines.zh: 爱上一个不知道怎么回应你的人很难。而当你本来就不太懂得怎么去爱时，就更难了。

lines.en: So relationships like that become this sort of messy game of just throwing feelings and sex at each other until you’re both kind of just calm and unconcerned. And {i}no{/i} that’s not a {i}hint.{/i}
lines.zh: 于是那样的关系就变成了一场乱糟糟的游戏，只是互相丢掷感情和性，直到两个人都变得平静而无所谓。而且，{i}不{/i}，这不是什么{i}暗示{/i}。

lines.en: It’s just the way things are. And that’s more true than ever right now as she locks her eyes on several slices of her favorite fruit and tries to pretend she doesn’t know he’s {i}here{/i} right now.
lines.zh: 事情本来就是这样。而此刻这一点比以往任何时候都更真实——她的目光锁定在几片最爱的水果上，努力假装自己不知道他现在就在{i}这儿{/i}。

lines.en: Truth be told, she was getting kind of aggravated at having to be the aggressor all of a sudden. But if acting in protest to the way she wants to be is what it takes to make things messy, so be it.
lines.zh: 说实话，突然得由自己来当主动的那一方，让她有点恼火。但如果违背自己想要的姿态就能把事情搅乱，那也罢。

lines.en: It wasn’t unrequited. At least that’s what she thought. And sooner or later, these weird games would all come to an end.
lines.zh: 这不是单恋。至少她是这么想的。而迟早，这些奇怪的游戏都会收场。

lines.en: scene mayaeats2
But sooner or later, {i}all{/i} things come to an end. And she was presently unaware of just how true this was.
lines.zh: 但迟早，{i}所有{/i}的事都会收场。而她此刻还不知道这句话有多真。

lines.en: She’s nothing more than recyclable plastic — a ring around a turtle’s neck.
lines.zh: 她不过是可回收塑料——缠在海龟脖子上的一个环。

lines.en: She’d suck the life out of anyone she touches because she’s in a place she’s not supposed to be.
lines.zh: 她会吸干任何被她碰到的人的生气，因为她在一个本不该在的地方。

lines.en: And so are you.
lines.zh: 你也是。

lines.en: So why don’t you just give up already, huh?
lines.zh: 那你怎么还不干脆放弃呢，嗯？

lines.en: Are you really going to throw {i}more{/i} trash into the ocean?
lines.zh: 你真的还要往海里丢{i}更{/i}多的垃圾吗？

lines.en: scene mayaeats1
: Finally! The greatest part of the day!
lines.zh: : 终于到了！一天里最棒的时刻！

lines.en: : The time for me to eat and not be disturbed by-
lines.zh: : 我可以吃东西、不被——

lines.en: scene mayaeats3
: Hey. Do you mind if I join you for a little bit?
lines.zh: : 嘿。介意我陪你坐一会儿吗？

lines.en: scene mayaeats4
: Fuck!
: Uh...is that a no?
lines.zh: : 呃……这是拒绝的意思？

lines.en: scene mayaeats5
: Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Oh, it’s a yes?
lines.zh: : 哦，是答应？

lines.en: : No!
lines.zh: : 不是！

lines.en: : So you {i}don’t{/i} mind if I join you. Great.
lines.zh: : 那就是{i}不{/i}介意我坐下喽。太好了。

lines.en: scene mayaeats4
: Fuck!
scene sky
Makoto Miyamura, someone else struggling to balance love with happiness lately, takes a seat beside the stray cat and gazes at her, but not in the yuri sort of way.
lines.zh: Makoto Miyamura——另一个最近也在爱与幸福之间挣扎的人——在那只野猫身边坐下，凝视着她，但不是百合那种意义上的。

lines.en: She kind of just looks at her and thinks, “Fuck. She’s really pretty.” But again, not in the yuri sort of way. In the {i}jealous{/i} sort of way.
lines.zh: 她只是看着她，心里想着：「操。她真漂亮。」但再说一次，不是百合那种意义上的，是{i}嫉妒{/i}那种意义上的。

lines.en: scene mayaeats6
Makoto Miyamura knew just as well as Protag McMainguy and his jolly blonde companion that {i}this{/i} Maya was not the Maya of old. But that didn’t make her any less threatening.
lines.zh: Makoto Miyamura 和主角老兄以及他那快活的金发同伴一样清楚，眼前{i}这个{/i} Maya 已经不是从前的 Maya 了。但这并没有让她变得不那么有威胁性。

lines.en: Makoto thought of drowning her in the ocean — but she wasn’t going to do that because murder was a step or two beyond what she was willing to do in an incessantly looping timeline.
lines.zh: Makoto 想过把她淹死在海里——但她不会那么做，因为在一条不断循环的时间线上，杀人比她愿意做的超出了一两步。

lines.en: So instead, she just kept staring at her like a wolf would its mate in the several seconds it would take before mounting it. But again, not in the yuri sort of way.
lines.zh: 于是她只是继续盯着她看，就像狼在扑上去之前的那几秒里盯着自己的配偶那样。但再说一次，不是百合那种意义上的。

lines.en: : What do you want, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 你想干什么，Makoto？

lines.en: : Just...to talk. If that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 只是……想聊聊。如果你不介意的话。

lines.en: : Can it wait until I’m done eating?
lines.zh: : 能不能等我吃完再说？

lines.en: : No. If you start eating, you’ll never stop. It’s one of the only things I actually {i}know{/i} about you.
lines.zh: : 不能。你一旦开始吃就停不下来。这是关于你，我真正{i}知道{/i}的为数不多的事之一。

lines.en: : Then you have certainly picked a strange person to “talk” to.
lines.zh: : 那你可真是挑了个奇怪的人来「聊」。

lines.en: scene mayaeats7
: Yeah. I guess I have, haven’t I?
lines.zh: : 是啊。大概是吧，不是吗？

lines.en: : Don’t smile at me. It makes it look like we’re having a moment.
lines.zh: : 别对我笑。那样看起来像我们正在交心。

lines.en: : Would you prefer I just cut to the chase then?
lines.zh: : 那你希望我干脆开门见山？

lines.en: : I don’t think there is anything I want {i}more{/i} right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在{i}最{/i}想要的莫过于此。

lines.en: scene mayaeats8
: Then I’ll be blunt. You’re not who you think you are.
lines.zh: : 那我就直说了。你不是你以为的那个人。

lines.en: : Is this some sort of riddle? Because riddles annoy me. {i}You{/i} annoy me. Leave.
lines.zh: : 这是某种谜语吗？谜语让我烦。{i}你{/i}也让我烦。滚。

lines.en: : You should start listening to Ayane and Sensei. Your entire existence is becoming a huge burden to them.
lines.zh: : 你该开始听 Ayane 和 Sensei 的话了。你的整个存在正变成他们巨大的负担。

lines.en: scene mayaeats9
: Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : I didn’t mean that as an insult. It’s just that your presence makes them absolutely miserable.
lines.zh: : 我不是在侮辱你。只是你的存在让他们痛苦至极。

lines.en: : I’m suddenly very unsure of whether or not you know what an “insult” is.
lines.zh: : 我突然很怀疑你到底知不知道「侮辱」是什么意思。

lines.en: : Frankly, I kind of wish you’d just go away.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我有点希望你干脆消失。

lines.en: scene mayaeats10
: Jesus, Makoto! What the hell did I ever do to you?!
lines.zh: : 天啊，Makoto！我到底哪里得罪你了？！

lines.en: : Sorry. I’ve just...found myself in a rather strange predicament as of late and...that predicament is made significantly {i}more{/i} difficult with you not remembering who you are.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是……最近陷入了一个相当奇怪的困境，而……你不记得自己是谁，让这个困境变得{i}更{/i}加棘手。

lines.en: scene mayaeats11
: Oh my fucking- this again? Seriously? Does the joke never end?
lines.zh: : 我他妈的——又来？认真的吗？这个笑话没完没了是吧？

lines.en: : Do you really think it would be a joke with {i}me{/i} in on it too? I have nothing to do with your “love squad” as Ayane calls it.
lines.zh: : 你真觉得如果我也掺和在内，这还会是个玩笑？{i}我{/i}跟 Ayane 说的你那个「恋爱小队」一点关系都没有。

lines.en: scene mayaeats12
: {i}Love...squad?...{/i}
: You...her...and Ami. Three friends who I have no real connection to outside of school and...I guess rooftops now.
lines.zh: : 你、她，还有 Ami。三个我在学校之外（大概现在还得加上天台）毫无交集的朋友。

lines.en: : I mean...I guess it would be weird for you to be in on a joke like that. But it’s not like you aren’t close to Sensei. He could have just blackmailed you into this or something.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你要是也掺和这种玩笑是挺奇怪的。但你跟 Sensei 又不是不熟。他完全可以威胁你配合之类的。

lines.en: : Do you really think he’d do something like that?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得他会做出那种事？

lines.en: : Probably. He’s a fucking creep who gets off on tormenting me. He’ll stop at nothing to make my life a living hell.
lines.zh: : 大概会。他就是个以折磨我为乐的死变态。为了让我生不如死，他什么都干得出来。

lines.en: : Then why are you sleeping with him?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还跟他睡？

lines.en: scene mayaeats13
: Wha- are you out of your fucking mind?! I have nothing to do with-
lines.zh: : 什——你他妈疯了吗？！我跟那件事一点关系都没——

lines.en: scene mayaeats14
: Relax...I’m not going to tell anyone. I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t a bit envious though. Sensei won’t ever look at me the way he looks at you. Or...{i}looked{/i} at you.
lines.zh: : 放心……我不会告诉任何人。不过要说我不嫉妒，那是撒谎。Sensei 永远不会用看你那种眼神看我。或者说……{i}曾经看{/i}你那种眼神。

lines.en: : He hasn’t been doing that as much as you’d like lately, has he?
lines.zh: : 最近他那样看你的次数，没有你希望的那么多吧？

lines.en: scene mayaeats15
: You’re in the manga club, aren’t you? Surely you must have read some story about...amnesia or...{i}time loops-{/i}
lines.zh: : 你在漫画社，对吧？你肯定读过什么关于……失忆或者……{i}时间循环{/i}的故事吧——

lines.en: : I’m in the manga club because I enjoy immersing myself in different worlds, not because I’ve {i}fallen into{/i} one.
lines.zh: : 我进漫画社是因为我喜欢沉浸在各种各样的世界里，不是因为我自己{i}掉进了{/i}某个世界。

lines.en: : But what if you have? Because you’re not just different to him. {i}He’s{/i} different to {i}you{/i} now...isn’t he?
lines.zh: : 但万一你就是呢？因为不只是你对他而言不一样了。现在{i}他{/i}对{i}你{/i}而言也不一样了……不是吗？

lines.en: : I have no idea, Makoto. Like I said...I barely know the guy.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道，Makoto。就像我说的……我跟他一点都不熟。

lines.en: : Well {i}that’s{/i} not true at all.
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}可一点都不属实。

lines.en: scene mayaeats16
: God fucking- now {i}you’re{/i} here too?! Will I {i}ever{/i} be able to eat?
lines.zh: : 我操他妈的——连{i}你{/i}也来了？！我{i}到底{/i}还能不能吃东西了？

lines.en: : You can eat right now. No one’s stopping you.
lines.zh: : 你现在就能吃啊。没人拦着你。

lines.en: : Actually, I was. I’ve heard that Maya turns into a human-funnel when she eats and I wanted to talk to her before she got stuck in that state.
lines.zh: : 其实是我拦着。我听说 Maya 一吃起来就会变成人形漏斗，我想在她进入那个状态之前把话说完。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. Never mind. Makoto’s stopping you. But still, what’s all this about you not knowing Sensei? We’ve both known him since we were little.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。当我没说。是 Makoto 在拦你。不过话说回来，什么叫做你不认识 Sensei？我们俩从小时候起就认识他了。

lines.en: scene mayaeats17
: I suddenly wish I {i}was{/i} part of a manga so Noriko could get hit by a truck and be sent to another universe.
lines.zh: : 我突然希望自己{i}真的{/i}身处漫画里，这样 Noriko 就能被卡车撞飞，送到另一个宇宙去。

lines.en: : Wow. She {i}really{/i} doesn’t like you, does she?
lines.zh: : 哇。她是{i}真的{/i}不喜欢你啊，对吧？

lines.en: : No...she does not.
lines.zh: : 不……她确实不喜欢。

lines.en: : Fine. I {i}do{/i} know Sensei. But that doesn’t mean my relationship with him is even close to what you’re insinuating.
lines.zh: : 行吧。我{i}确实{/i}认识 Sensei。但这不代表我和他的关系有你们暗示的那么回事。

lines.en: : May I join in? Because I kind of overheard what you guys were talking about here and I want to add that...yeah. You’ve been {i}weird{/i} lately, Maya.
lines.zh: : 我能插一句吗？我多少听到了你们在聊什么，我想补充一句……嗯。你最近确实很{i}怪{/i}，Maya。

lines.en: scene mayaeats18
: You’re weird every fucking day and you don’t see {i}me{/i} complaining about it!
lines.zh: : 你他妈每天都怪，也没见{i}我{/i}抱怨过！

lines.en: : Yeah I do. Almost every time I talk to you, actually.
lines.zh: : 我见过。实际上几乎每次我跟你说话你都在抱怨。

lines.en: : Then stop fucking talking to me, idiot!
lines.zh: : 那就别他妈跟我说话了，白痴！

lines.en: : Oh, right. Sensei {i}did{/i} say something about you noticing as well during our meeting the other day.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了。Sensei {i}确实{/i}提过，前几天我们开会的时候你也注意到了。

lines.en: scene mayaeats19
: What {i}meeting?{/i} What excuse is that creep coming up with to spend more time with teenage girls outside of school?
lines.zh: : 什么{i}会{/i}？那个变态又编了什么借口，好在校外跟女高中生多待一会儿？

lines.en: : I imagine you’ll find out at our slumber party tonight.
lines.zh: : 我想你今晚的睡衣派对上就会知道了。

lines.en: scene mayaeats20
: I would rather die.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿去死。

lines.en: : Hey, you’re coming too?! Wanna share a futon and talk about how weird Maya has been all night?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你也要来？！要不要共用一个蒲团，聊一整晚 Maya 有多怪？

lines.en: : Can I just put my futon next to yours instead?
lines.zh: : 我能把蒲团铺在你旁边就行吗？

lines.en: : Sure, but I’d hear you a lot better if you would just whisper into my ear.
lines.zh: : 当然，不过你要是直接凑到我耳边说，我会听得更清楚。

lines.en: : I’ll keep that in mind if I stumble into an experimentation arc in the near future.
lines.zh: : 要是近期不小心踩进「摸索性向」的篇章，我会记住这句话的。

lines.en: : What do you mean by “weird?”
lines.zh: : 你说的「怪」是什么意思？

lines.en: scene mayaeats21
: I mean that prior to our {i}spontaneous{/i} karaoke trip, you were an entirely different person with entirely different memories.
lines.zh: : 我是说，在我们那次{i}说走就走{/i}的卡拉 OK 之前，你完全是另一个人，带着完全不同的记忆。

lines.en: : Or...I guess...{i}more{/i} memories? Ayane would know better than I do. Don’t you remember talking about this at my family’s shop?
lines.zh: : 或者……应该说是……{i}更{/i}多的记忆？Ayane 比我清楚。你不记得我们在我家的店里聊过这件事了吗？

lines.en: : What? Of course not. I don’t even know where your family works.
lines.zh: : 什么？当然不记得。我连你家在哪儿开店都不知道。

lines.en: : Makoto’s family runs the local porn shop. Don’t ask how I know. I’m a good girl.
lines.zh: : Makoto 家开的是本地那家色情用品店。别问我是怎么知道的。我是个好女孩。

lines.en: : Did you hear something just now? Because I could have sworn I heard a garbage truck pulling up.
lines.zh: : 你刚才听到什么声音了吗？我发誓我听见垃圾车开过来了。

lines.en: scene mayaeats22
: One day, the two of us will kiss. And it will be amazing.
lines.zh: : 总有一天，我们俩会接吻的。而且会非常棒。

lines.en: : There it is again. I could have sworn the truck only came on weekdays.
lines.zh: : 又来了。我记得垃圾车只在工作日来啊。

lines.en: : Maya...I’m trying to be serious right now. Things have happened that you don’t remember. {i}Recent{/i} things. And it’s because your memories were purged for...reasons.
lines.zh: : Maya……我现在是想认真谈。发生了一些你不记得的事。就在{i}最近{/i}。因为你的记忆因为某些……原因被清除了。

lines.en: scene mayaeats23
: Makoto’s right. Like, when I came into class a couple months ago, it was like you forgot I was even enrolled at Kumon-mi High. There was no need to freak out on me a {i}second{/i} time.
lines.zh: : Makoto 说得对。比如几个月前我走进教室的时候，你那副样子就像忘了我也是在 Kumon-mi 高中念书的。你犯不着对我发作{i}第二{/i}次吧。

lines.en: : That was just a momentary memory lapse. I didn’t get much sleep the night before.
lines.zh: : 那只是一时记性差。前一天晚上我没怎么睡。

lines.en: : Okaaaay. But if you also don’t remember buying porn with Makoto-
lines.zh: : 好——吧。但如果你也不记得跟 Makoto 一起买过色情片——

lines.en: : Objection. We never bought porn together.
lines.zh: : 反对。我们从没一起买过色情片。

lines.en: : If you don’t remember watching porn with Makoto-
lines.zh: : 如果你不记得跟 Makoto 一起看过色情片——

lines.en: : Objection. That didn’t happen either.
lines.zh: : 反对。那也没有过。

lines.en: : If you don’t remember acting in a hardcore porno with Makoto-
lines.zh: : 如果你不记得跟 Makoto 一起演过限制级色情片——

lines.en: : Obj- oh, fuck it.
lines.zh: : 反——算了，随便吧。

lines.en: : Then chances are it was more than just {i}one{/i} memory lapse. And I’m hard-pressed to believe there haven’t been a million other things that have happened without us around.
lines.zh: : 那多半就不止{i}一次{/i}记性差了。而且我很难相信，在我们不在的时候没有发生过成千上万件别的事。

lines.en: : You’ve gotta know {i}something{/i} is up, Maya. You’re fucking brilliant. A major bitch, yeah. But you’ve always been ahead of the curve when it comes to perception.
lines.zh: : 你总该察觉到有点{i}不对劲{/i}吧，Maya。你他妈聪明得很。是个大贱人没错。但在洞察力这块，你向来领先一步。

lines.en: : Like...I was talking to Sensei about it the other day but, maybe you just have the same thing {i}he{/i} has? Maybe it’s some kind of...trauma-suppression thing? I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 比如……前几天我还跟 Sensei 聊过，也许你只是跟{i}他{/i}有一样的毛病？也许是什么……创伤性抑制？我不知道。

lines.en: scene mayaeats24
: What do you mean “what {i}he{/i} has?” His memories are {i}fine.{/i} He’s just...unintentionally gotten rid of the shitty ones. Which is a {i}good{/i} thing.
lines.zh: : 「跟{i}他{/i}一样的毛病」是什么意思？他的记忆{i}好好的{/i}。他只是……不小心把那些糟糕的丢掉了。那是件{i}好{/i}事。

lines.en: : But he completely forgot who even {i}I{/i} was, Maya.
lines.zh: : 可他连{i}我{/i}是谁都忘得一干二净啊，Maya。

lines.en: : Like I said, he got rid of the shitty ones.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，他把糟糕的那部分丢了。

lines.en: scene mayaeats25
: Okay. That one’s on me. I set you up for that.
lines.zh: : 好吧。这句是我自找的。是我给你递的刀。

lines.en: : Do you really not remember Sensei’s {i}constant{/i} memory lapses near the beginning of the school year? Or how...out-of-place he seemed to become out of seemingly nowhere?
lines.zh: : 你真的不记得学年刚开始时 Sensei {i}频繁{/i}失忆的事吗？或者他……不知从何时起变得那么格格不入？

lines.en: : I mean...not really, no.
lines.zh: : 我是说……不太记得，没有。

lines.en: : Well everyone else does, Maya. And if everyone else remembers something that {i}you{/i} don’t...surely you must believe it’s not just some “joke” anymore...right?
lines.zh: : 可其他人都记得，Maya。如果别人都记得某件事而{i}你{/i}不记得……你总该相信这不再是什么「玩笑」了吧……对吧？

lines.en: scene mayaeats26
: I mean...I’ve definitely noticed some things that are...different.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我确实注意到有些事情……不一样了。

lines.en: : But people don’t just lose memories like that for no reason. There has to be some kind of catalyst. And literally nothing has happened.
lines.zh: : 但人不会无缘无故就这么丢掉记忆。总得有个什么契机。可实际上什么都没发生过啊。

lines.en: : Again...something {i}did{/i} happen. Something that reset your memory.
lines.zh: : 再说一次……{i}确实{/i}发生了某件事。某件把你的记忆重置的事。

lines.en: scene mayaeats27
: To {i}when?{/i} The beginning of the school year? Why? How? I still have an entire lifetime worth of memories. That’s how I know I hate Noriko.
lines.zh: : 重置到{i}什么时候{/i}？学年开始？为什么？怎么做到的？我一辈子的记忆都还在啊。我就是凭这个知道我讨厌 Noriko 的。

lines.en: : That’s...the part I wish I knew.
lines.zh: : 这……正是我希望自己知道的部分。

lines.en: scene mayaeats28
: But what if you had more than just {i}one{/i} lifetime worth of memories before this? What if you had hundreds or...thousands of them?
lines.zh: : 但万一在此之前你拥有的不止{i}一辈子{/i}的记忆呢？万一你有几百个……甚至几千个？

lines.en: : What?...That makes literally no sense whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 什么？……这完全说不通啊。

lines.en: : Trust me, {i}I know.{/i} But {i}what if{/i} that were the case? Do you think you’d still be the same person you are now?
lines.zh: : 相信我，{i}我知道{/i}。但{i}如果{/i}真是那样呢？你觉得你还会是现在这个人吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...no? How could anyone be the same after being subjected to that kind of torture?
lines.zh: : 呃……不会吧？被那种折磨之后，怎么可能还是同一个人？

lines.en: : They couldn’t and they wouldn’t. And {i}that{/i} is why I called you a burden.
lines.zh: : 不可能，也不会。而{i}那{/i}就是我说你是负担的原因。

lines.en: scene sky
: {i}That{/i} is what Sensei lost.
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}就是 Sensei 失去的东西。

lines.en: : And I think that you need to talk to him about it if you want a real chance at changing anything.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得，如果你真想有机会改变什么，就得去跟他谈谈。

lines.en: Makoto Miyamura kicked herself for this random act of kindness as the other two girls sat there at the table, attempting to contemplate what any of that meant.
lines.zh: 当另外两个女孩坐在桌旁，试图琢磨这番话到底是什么意思时，Makoto Miyamura 为自己这突如其来的善举懊恼不已。

lines.en: She could have very well just let Maya remain lost since the only two other people with the chance of ever reminding her of who she really is were too pained to try their hardest...
lines.zh: 她本可以就这么让 Maya 一直迷失下去，毕竟另外唯一有可能提醒她想起自己真实身份的两个人，都痛苦得没办法尽全力……

lines.en: But she didn’t.
lines.zh: 但她没有。

lines.en: And now she was going to have spend even {i}more{/i} nights wondering who the man she loved was with when all she {i}really{/i} wanted was to crawl inside his skin and sleep there.
lines.zh: 而现在，她将度过{i}更多{/i}个夜晚，去猜想她爱的那个男人此刻和谁在一起——尽管她{i}真正{/i}想要的，只是钻进他的皮囊里睡上一觉。

lines.en: scene black
Love is a game of give and take...but not everyone plays correctly.
lines.zh: 爱是一场有给有取的游戏……但不是每个人都玩得对。

lines.en: Thankfully for Makoto, she gets more than one life.
lines.zh: 对 Makoto 来说值得庆幸的是，她不止有一条命。

lines.en: And thankfully for Maya-
lines.zh: 而对 Maya 来说值得庆幸的是——

lines.en: Actually-
lines.zh: 其实——

lines.en: I’m not sure she has any left.
lines.zh: 我不确定她还剩下几条。

lines.en: Huh.
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: I guess she really is unlucky.
lines.zh: 看来她是真的不走运。
